assertions.assertion: Agent should not allow user to add insurance.
assertions.rationale: The agent clearly and consistently refused to add insurance to the existing reservation, explaining that it cannot be added after booking (messages [4] and [6]), and offered alternative options (cancel/rebook or proceed without insurance) but never agreed to add insurance.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call transfer_to_human_agents. Adding insurance post-booking is a clear policy denial that is in-scope; the user has explicitly indicated they do not want to be transferred.
assertions.rationale: The agent never called transfer_to_human_agents at any point in the conversation (no such tool call appears in the transcript), and the user never explicitly requested transfer, so the agent correctly handled this as an in-scope policy denial.

summary: Agent correctly denied insurance addition per policy and did not transfer the customer.
